saints.name: St. Nicholas of Tolentino
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: An Augustinian friar and preacher of Tolentino, famed for his charity and for his prayers for the souls in purgatory…
biography: Born about 1245 at Sant'Angelo in the March of Ancona, Nicholas joined the Hermits of St. Augustine as a young man and spent most of his life at Tolentino. A gentle and untiring preacher and confessor, he ministered to the poor and the sick of the town for some thirty years.

He was especially devoted to praying for the dead, and the custom of "St. Nicholas bread," blessed and given to the sick and the needy, spread from his name. He died in 1305 and became the first member of his order to be canonized, in 1446.
saints.knownFor: His preaching, his charity, and his intercession for the holy souls.
